ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Scheme in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent guilty pleas in the Minnesota Medicaid scheme and explore the broader implications for the Medicaid system.
questions: What are the root causes of the Medicaid scheme?
How can the Medicaid system be improved to prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a larger pattern of fraud in the Medicaid system and highlight the need for reform.

ideas.title: The Impact of Funding Freezes on Infrastructure Projects
ideas.description: This story would explore the impact of funding freezes on infrastructure projects, using the Gateway Tunnel project as a case study.
questions: What are the short-term and long-term consequences of funding freezes on infrastructure projects?
How can funding freezes be prevented or mitigated in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the importance of stable federal funding for infrastructure projects and the need for more transparency and accountability in government spending.
